changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rental_inspections ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, rental_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES rentals(id), type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('CHECK_IN','CHECK_OUT')), odometer INTEGER, fuel_level SMALLINT, notes TEXT, photo_urls TEXT[], performed_by UUID, performed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rental_inspections_rental_type ON rental_inspections(rental_id, type);
